title: Wild Clay Workshop: Pit-Fire Pottery with Chonkush Tusa dePalatine
source_quote: Wild Clay Workshop — Tue, Oct 6, 2026 8:00 AM to Sun, Oct 11, 2026 6:30 PM
evidence_sentence: This 5-day workshop includes pit-firing and hand-building pottery with wild clays, with optional day-of-firing registration.
summary: Five-day intensive workshop in Jefferson County near Quilcene featuring hand-built pottery with wild clays and pit-firing. Participants harvest and process clays, hand-build forms, and finish with a ceremonial pit-fire. Tuition $350–450 plus $50 nonrefundable deposit; work-trade positions available. Register online or for the firing day only.
bring: hand-building pottery tools, firewood (optional), any wild clays you want to test
commitment: Tue Oct 6–Sun Oct 11, 2026; optional $40 day-of-firing registration
how_to_join: Pay $50 deposit via Venmo (@chonkush) or PayPal (chimacumcircle@protonmail.com) and click the registration link; or register for firing day only for $40
